_note: Gemma 4 stays on its built-in loader. Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE), per-layer sliding/full attention types and KV sharing need code (src/model/gemma_mapper.rs), so this descriptor only declares the config fields and named quirks; the built-in weight mapper is still used at inference time. The descriptor exists so `models check` recognises a Gemma 4 config instead of refusing it by name.
name: gemma4
